incidents.name: Stars Arena share-buy reentrancy
incidents.notes: The share-buy entry point (selector 0xe9ccf3a3) sent AVAX back to the caller before finalising share accounting, letting the attacker re-enter the weight-setting function (selector 0x5632b2e4) mid-call so that a single share could then be sold via sellShares() for ~266,000 AVAX.

sources.ref: onchain review: proxy 0xa481b139a1a654ca19d2074f174f17d7534e8cec created 2023-09-20 by 0xb7461cf331a3a940e69b9deea98fa43fd357f571 (Stars Arena deployer), unrelated to attack sender 0xa2ebf3fcd757e9be1e58b643b6b5077d11b4ad7a; 2 EIP-1967 Upgraded events, the last on 2023-10-05 to implementation 0x8af92c23a169b58c2e5ac656d8d8a23fc725080f - 1.7 days before the incident, an upgrade shipped after a smaller 2023-10-05 exploit of the same contract; 266,103 AVAX ~= $2.88M
